channel.title: Can I Play That? - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Can I Play That? (caniplaythat.com)

item.title: Rainbow Gate accessibility review - Can I Play That?
item.description: Rainbow Gate has subtitle support for many languages but missing remapping and difficult visuals hold back the game's accessibility.

item.title: High on Life 2 highlights importance of accessibility in menus - Can I Play That?
item.description: High on Life 2 features a bunch of accessibility features, but the menus can make it difficult to find and adjust them.

item.title: PlayStation shuts door on studio and PC ports, raising accessibility concerns - Can I Play That?
item.description: Closing Bluepoint Games and canceling PC ports raises some concerns about the accessibility of PlayStation titles past, present, and future.

item.title: Dimensional Double Shift gets Snap Turn to improve accessibility - Can I Play That?
item.description: Update 1.9 adds Snap Turn to the accessibility options in VR game Dimensional Double Shift, allowing players to turn around without moving.

item.title: Early 2026 game accessibility awards recap - Can I Play That?
item.description: At the tail end of the awards season we take a look at several game accessibility awards given out in early 2026.

item.title: Megapop shares Life Below accessibility trailer on social media - Can I Play That?
item.description: Megapop shared an accessibility trailer detailing the features and options available in their upcoming game Life Below.

item.title: Dynamic Reactions - Community Voices - Can I Play That?
item.description: In this edition of Community Voices we turn the spotlight on Kennedie Griggs, also known as Dynamic Reactions.

item.title: Switch 2 system update adds screen reader to first time setup - Can I Play That?
item.description: The latest Nintendo Switch 2 system update improves accessibility by extending screen reader support and adding notes to the friends list.

item.title: The top rated games from Games for Blind Gamers 5 - Can I Play That?
item.description: Games for Blind Gamers 5 concluded, we take a look at the top rated games from this blind accessibility focused game jam.

item.title: Logitech shares 3D files for adaptive Pebble Mouse add-ons - Can I Play That?
item.description: Logitech shared 3D printable files for 3 adaptive add-ons for their Pebble Mouse, and a 3D model to help the community to design their own.

item.title: Elisabeth (Arevya) Sivertsen - Community Voices - Can I Play That?
item.description: In this edition of Community Voices we turn the spotlight on Elisabeth Sivertsen, also known as Arevya.

item.title: Introducing CaptionsRush, live captioning Discord voice chat while gaming - Can I Play That?
item.description: CaptionsRush is a new live captioning system for voice chat and others, using cloud based or local speech-to-text transcription.

item.title: ByoWave Proteus Controller Kit V2 accessibility review - Can I Play That?
item.description: The Proteus Controller Kit by ByoWave is as modular as a controller can be, from hardware configuration to input remapping and settings.

item.title: ByoWave Proteus Builder accessibility review - Can I Play That?
item.description: The one-handed Proteus Builder by ByoWave is an effective keyboard replacement and a more affordable introduction in the Proteus ecosystem.
